text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2428

g.text: Modelled automobiles as a share of places, area by area: the status colours of the corridor charts on a map
Each area fronting the lane: automobiles registered to its households (MODELLED from the SAAQ file of 2024) as a percentage of its places (MEASURED).
A: places at the curb and private places of small buildings. B: places at the curb alone, the case in which every registered automobile is kept on the street.
A share compares registered vehicles with capacity; it is not a measure of how full the street is (no occupancy has been counted since the lane was built). Curb: legal curb by block face,
an upper bound (driveways, hydrants, bus stops, hourly and permit rules not deducted). Private places: cars that can leave without another being moved, small buildings only; garage
interiors and the 96 larger buildings' garages not counted. Automobiles: the central estimate; each area's 90 % interval is in the corridor-parking-map table.
Sources: SAAQ, vehicles released under the access Act (file 03.06.34729), December 31, 2024, type inferred; Statistics Canada, 2021 Census;
City of Montréal, géobase, parking-sign inventory and assessment roll (CC BY 4.0). Automobiles below the FSA are MODELLED, not measured.
